```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(Seurat)
```

```{r setup}
if(Sys.getenv("POSITRON") == "1"){
    setwd(here::here())
    params <- rmarkdown::yaml_front_matter(rstudioapi::getSourceEditorContext()$path)$params
}
```





```{r}
source("./pipe.R")
input = pipeline$pathways_for_Nichenet$input
output = pipeline$pathways_for_Nichenet$output
```


```{r}
t_cells_labled = readRDS(file = input$t_cells_labled)
starCAT_pathways_metadata  = readxl::read_excel(path = input$starCAT_pathways_metadata,sheet = 1,skip = 14)
```


```{r}
pathways_to_check = starCAT_pathways_metadata %>% filter(`GEP Class` == "Functional") %>% pull(`Short Name`) %>% gsub(pattern = "/",replacement = ".") %>% gsub(pattern = "-",replacement = "_")
pathways_to_check
```

```{r}
FeaturePlot(object = t_cells_labled, features = pathways_to_check[1:12], combine = FALSE) %>% 
  lapply(function(x) x + theme(legend.position = "bottom")) %>% 
  cowplot::plot_grid(plotlist = .,ncol = 4)

FeaturePlot(object = t_cells_labled, features = pathways_to_check[13:24], combine = FALSE) %>% 
  lapply(function(x) x + theme(legend.position = "bottom")) %>% 
  cowplot::plot_grid(plotlist = .,ncol = 4)
```

```{r}
t_cells_labled$t_cell_label <- case_match(
  t_cells_labled$t_cell_label,
  c("CD4_EM", "CD4_CM", "CD4_Naive") ~ "CD4_T",
  c("CD8_CM", "CD8_Naive", "CD8_TEMRA", "CD8_EM") ~ "CD8_T",
  .default = as.character(t_cells_labled$t_cell_label)
)
```
```{r}
# get active cells percntage per program
threshold = 0.025

for (t_type in unique(t_cells_labled$t_cell_label)){
  print(t_type)
  t_type_data = subset(t_cells_labled, t_cell_label == t_type)
  active_cells_per_program = t_type_data@meta.data %>% 
    select(all_of(pathways_to_check)) %>% 
    summarise(across(everything(), ~sum(.x > threshold) / n())) %>% 
    pivot_longer(cols = everything(),names_to = "program",values_to = "active_cells") %>% 
    arrange(desc(active_cells))
# barplot
  p = ggplot2::ggplot(active_cells_per_program, aes(x = reorder(program,active_cells), y = active_cells)) +
    geom_bar(stat = "identity") +
    coord_flip() +
    theme_bw() +
    labs(x = "Program", y = "Active cells percentage") +
    scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent_format(accuracy = 1))+
    ggtitle(paste0("Active cells percentage per program in ", t_type))
  print(p)
}
```

```{r}
active_pathway_threshold = 0.1 # if 0.1 of the cells in a cell type are active for a pathway, we consider it active in this cell type
active_pathways_per_cell_type = list()
for (t_type in unique(t_cells_labled$t_cell_label)){
  t_type_data = subset(t_cells_labled, t_cell_label == t_type)
  active_cells_per_program = t_type_data@meta.data %>% 
    select(all_of(pathways_to_check)) %>% 
    summarise(across(everything(), ~sum(.x > threshold) / n())) %>% 
    pivot_longer(cols = everything(),names_to = "program",values_to = "active_cells") %>% 
    arrange(desc(active_cells))
  active_pathways = active_cells_per_program %>% filter(active_cells > active_pathway_threshold) %>% pull(program)
  active_pathways_per_cell_type[[t_type]] = active_pathways
}
```


```{r}
saveRDS(active_pathways_per_cell_type, file = output$T_pathways_for_Nichenet)
```
